description: This file implements a plugin for the lighttpd web server, providing a server status and statistics interface with multiple output formats (HTML, Plain Text, JSON). It includes configuration handling, request handlers, and trigger functions for updating server metrics.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Structure holding plugin configuration URLs and sorting flag.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main data structure for tracking server statistics, configuration, and per-connection metrics.

methods.name: mod_status_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges individual configuration value into plugin configuration.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges plugin configuration settings from provided config plugin value list.

methods.name: void mod_status_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on current request and plugin defaults.

methods.name: mod_status_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin and initializes configuration.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append_sort(buffer * b,const plugin_config * const pconf,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Appends HTML table header with optional sorting link for the status page.

methods.name: void mod_status_get_multiplier(buffer * b,double avg,int size)
methods.description: Converts a numeric value into a human-readable unit with scale suffix.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable_r(buffer * const b,const request_st * const r,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Appends a row to the HTML status table with connection details.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable(request_st * const rq,const server * const srv,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Builds the complete HTML table of current server connections.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_html(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Generates and sends the server status page in HTML format.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_text(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Generates and sends server status information in plain text.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_json(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Generates and sends server status information in JSON format, supports JSONP callback.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_statistics(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles status request for server statistics in plain text format.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Dispatches to the correct status format handler based on URL query parameter.

methods.name: void mod_status_row_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen,const char * v,size_t vlen)
methods.description: Appends a table row with key-value data in HTML format.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Appends a table header section in HTML format.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_config(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Generates a configuration overview page.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handler(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Main request handler that dispatches status, config, or statistics pages based on URL.

methods.name: mod_status_trigger
methods.description: Periodic trigger function updating server metrics.

methods.name: mod_status_account
methods.description: Request completion hook updating request metrics.

methods.name: int mod_status_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Plugin initialization function registering handlers and hooks for lighttpd.
